description: This PHP class 'AutoTOCAdder' automatically inserts a Table of Contents placeholder in Markdown documents parsed by the CommonMark library if the auto-TOC feature is enabled and no TOC placeholder already exists. It interacts with configuration settings and manipulates the document's node tree.

classes.name: AutoTOCAdder
classes.description: A class that adds an automatic Table of Contents placeholder to Markdown documents if enabled and absent.

methods.name: onDocumentParsed
methods.description: Event handler invoked when a document is parsed; adds a TOC placeholder if conditions are met.

methods.name: isAutoTOC
methods.description: Checks whether the automatic TOC feature is enabled based on the configuration.

methods.name: hasTOCPlaceholder
methods.description: Determines if the document already contains a TOC placeholder node.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration object for the class.
